dedupe_keys.name: interventi di difesa idraulica post alluvione maggio 2023

description: Interventi di difesa idraulica post alluvione maggio 2023 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The map level contains all the emergency measures identified by Ordinance 6/2023 and 8/2023 specific to the rivers and canals in which the contracting authority is included in one of the following: AIPo, Civil Protection, Reclamation Consortia, ARPAE. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Post-flood hydraulic defence interventions May 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2023-11-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
